BatchSetDesktopManager.description_en: Adds or removes local administrator permissions for convenience accounts on cloud computers
BatchSetDesktopManager.description_zh: 为便捷账号添加或者去除云电脑的本地管理员权限

ChangeUserPassword.description_en: Modifies the logon password of a user when the user is in administrator activation mode
ChangeUserPassword.description_zh: 当用户为管理员激活模式时，可以通过该接口修改用户登录密码

CheckUsedProperty.description_en: Queries the number of convenience accounts that are associated with a specified custom property
CheckUsedProperty.description_zh: 查询关联了指定自定义属性的便捷账号的数量

CheckUsedPropertyValue.description_en: Queries the number of convenience accounts that are associated with a specified custom property value
CheckUsedPropertyValue.description_zh: 查询关联了指定自定义属性值的便捷账号的数量

CreateUsers.description_en: Creates convenience accounts for end users
CreateUsers.description_zh: 为终端用户创建便捷账号

DeleteUserPropertyValue.description_en: Removes the bindng between a user and a user property
DeleteUserPropertyValue.description_zh: 解除一个用户与某个用户属性的绑定关系

DescribeGroupUser.description_en: Queries the members of a user group

DescribeMfaDevices.description_en: Queries the virtual MFA devices bound to convenience accounts
DescribeMfaDevices.description_zh: 查询便捷账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

DescribeUser.description_en: Queries the basic information of a user

DescribeUsers.description_en: Queries convenience account information, such as usernames, email addresses, and remarks
DescribeUsers.description_zh: 查询便捷账号信息，例如用户名、邮箱地址、备注名称等

FilterUsers.description_en: Queries convenience account information filtered by user properties
FilterUsers.description_zh: 按用户属性筛选查询便捷账号信息

GetAdUsersCount.description_en: Retrieves the number of Active Directory (AD) domain users

GetManagerInfoByAuthCode.description_en: Retrieves the information of the currently logged-on administrator based on an authorization code
GetManagerInfoByAuthCode.description_zh: 根据authcode获取当前登录的管理员信息

GetUsersCount.description_en: Retrieves the total number of Elastic Desktop Service convenience users
GetUsersCount.description_zh: 获取无影便捷用户总数

ListProperty.description_en: Queries the list of existing user properties under the current account
ListProperty.description_zh: 查询当前账号下已有的用户属性列表

ListPropertyValue.description_en: Queries the list of property values contained in a user property
ListPropertyValue.description_zh: 查询某一用户属性包含的属性值列表

LockMfaDevice.description_en: Locks the virtual MFA device bound to a convenience account
LockMfaDevice.description_zh: 锁定便捷账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

LockUsers.description_en: Locks one or more convenience accounts. Locked convenience accounts cannot log on to Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) clients
LockUsers.description_zh: 锁定一个或者多个便捷账号。锁定后的便捷账号无法登录无影终端

ModifyGroup.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a user group
ModifyGroup.description_zh: 修改用户组的名称和描述

ModifyUser.description_en: Modifies the contact information of a convenience account
ModifyUser.description_zh: 修改便捷账号的联系方式

MoveUserOrg.description_en: Moves users to a target organization
MoveUserOrg.description_zh: 移动用户到目标组织架构

QuerySyncStatusByAliUid.description_en: Queries the identity synchronization status of a user

RemoveGroup.description_en: Deletes user groups. Batch operations are supported
RemoveGroup.description_zh: 删除用户组。支持批量操作

RemoveMfaDevice.description_en: Deletes the virtual MFA device bound to a convenience account
RemoveMfaDevice.description_zh: 删除便捷账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

RemoveProperty.description_en: Deletes a set of user properties

RemoveUsers.description_en: Deletes one or more convenience accounts
RemoveUsers.description_zh: 删除一个或者多个便捷账号

ResetUserPassword.description_en: Resets the passwords of convenience accounts, including generating password reset tokens and sending password reset emails to the email addresses of the convenience accounts
ResetUserPassword.description_zh: 重置便捷账号的密码，包括生成重置密码Token，并发送重置密码邮件到便捷账号的邮箱

SetUserPropertyValue.description_en: Associates a user property with a user
SetUserPropertyValue.description_zh: 为某个用户关联一个用户属性

TransferResourcesIntoGroup.description_en: Transfers resources to a resource group
TransferResourcesIntoGroup.description_zh: 将资源转移到资源组中

TransferResourcesOutofGroup.description_en: Moves resources out of a resource group
TransferResourcesOutofGroup.description_zh: 将资源从资源组中转出

UnlockMfaDevice.description_en: Unlocks the virtual MFA device bound to a convenience account
UnlockMfaDevice.description_zh: 解锁便捷账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备

UnlockUsers.description_en: Unlocks one or more convenience accounts. Unlocked convenience accounts can log on to Wuying terminals
UnlockUsers.description_zh: 解锁一个或者多个便捷账号。解锁后的便捷账号可以登录无影终端

UserBatchJoinGroup.description_en: Add users to a group in batch
UserBatchJoinGroup.description_zh: 为用户组批量添加用户

UserBatchQuitGroup.description_en: Removes users from a user group in batches
UserBatchQuitGroup.description_zh: 批量移除用户组中的用户
